workLog.entry: Triaged 26 open PRs with test_pr_merge_ready.py; 24 DIRTY, verified real conflicts via git merge-tree. Identified keystone PR 3643 (ADR-089 causal tier removal) gating 17 causal-graph.json conflicts.

Landed 3583 and 3608 (direct merge after four-condition gate). Resolved 3643 modify/delete conflict, renumbered its ADR to 089 after collision with main's 088, armed auto-merge. Delegated merge-resolver agents for 3590, 3581, 3576, 3560.

Fixed and resolved 30+ review threads across the queue (Copilot, semgrep, CodeRabbit) with code fixes: TEMP/TMP mirroring, --extra dev ratchets, nosemgrep with rationale, fail-closed gaps in coverage gate, chunked hashing, provenance sentinel. Manifest version ladder maintained across 0.6.146-0.6.170 and 0.3.46-0.3.53.

Keystone 3643 landed after 5 update cycles racing external merges; freed ARM runner starvation by sweep-cancelling ~110 queued sibling runs (all re-triggered by post-keystone refresh pushes). Post-keystone refresh waves re-resolved manifest and content conflicts.

Serial drain of remaining queue. Notable fixes: ADR-088 reference scenarios admitted to 3576's coverage gate with baseline refresh; 3587's validator wired into workflow; 3569 catalog regen removed committed conflict markers; 3560 seven-hunk union with restored error_count validation and ADR-087 amendment; commit-limit-bypass on 3569 and 3560 for merge churn. Root-caused phantom BLOCKED to required_review_thread_resolution with outdated-flagged threads.
